title: thelypteris gardneriana
intro: Thelypteris gardneriana, commonly known as the Fern-leaved Lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris gardneriana include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, cough, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
